title: THE MOON
message: A reflection can be true without being complete.
meaning:
The Moon is something understood indirectly.

The source itself remains hidden, while its reflection changes with every movement of the surface. What you perceive may still be real, even when it has been altered by memory, emotion or perspective.

The card asks you to separate what is there from the form in which you are currently seeing it.
imageAlt: Moonlight reflected across dark water beneath a clouded night sky
